$comment: The invented people of Krizaka's products — fictional adults generated by Orazaka (image-generation Studio, FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, Apache-2.0) on one Mac, signed in as Eric; owned by Krizaka. One face = one persona = one product (tests/people.test.mjs). Files: site/people/<product>/ on the CDN (lib/cdn.ts). `prompt` + `seed` + `size` + `model` remake an image. Credits: lib/people.credits.md. Yororis has none: its presences are drawn marks.

people.name: Alex Vance / Alex Carter
people.use: Orochia demo cast and development seed
people.prompt: A 31-year-old man, a late-night music fan, short dark-brown wavy hair, light stubble, olive skin, brown eyes, wearing a charcoal crew-neck knit sweater. Editorial head-and-shoulders portrait photograph, looking into the camera with a relaxed, natural expression. Soft key light from a large window on the left, gentle fill, a plain deep plum-to-charcoal seamless studio backdrop, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp eyes, natural skin texture with pores and small imperfections, no retouching, plain clothing without any print. Square composition, face centred in the upper half, shoulders visible. An ordinary fictional person, not a celebrity and not a fashion model. No text, no lettering, no logos.
